description: I will not rush my life #patience #selflove #selfleadership
transcript: I am patient, and I will wait, and I will wait for all of the things that I desire. I will wait for the things that I don't even know are coming my way, because I know that this life was built for me. I am patient, and I do not fear waiting. As I wait, I develop, and I prepare myself for what's coming. Even the things that I don't know about, patience allows me to be ready.
